# D1 depth test (generated by src/compare_depth.py, alpha = 0.2 rho)

Steer h_l at every valid position by alpha*rho*unit(dir); response at block l+k. rel_lin = |act - J d|/|act| (median over contexts x directions); rel_quad with J + Q/2. k is the absolute number of blocks traversed. `fin` = the final block.
